title: Gabber bound for affine opens of an excellent strictly local scheme
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $n\geq1$, and $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$. Let $X$ be a Noetherian excellent strictly henselian local scheme of finite Krull dimension $d\geq0$, with $\ell$ invertible [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-exc-excellent-ring, def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Let $V\subseteq X$ be an affine open subscheme [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For every sheaf $M$ of $\Lambda$-modules on the ordinary small etale site of $V$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], one has $$H^q(V,M)=0\qquad(q>d),$$ where $q$ is a nonnegative integer and $H^q$ is right-derived global-sections cohomology of the underlying abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. No constructibility of $M$ is assumed.

source.place: Expose XV, Corollary 1.2.2, printed p. 219, specialized to an affine open immersion; Expose XVII, proofs of Propositions 3.2.1 and 3.2.2, printed pp. 268–269, affine-open cohomological-dimension input. The result for arbitrary sheaves is the filtered-colimit extension of the constructible assertion.
